argv.notes: --session-id establishes new identity; --resume continues an existing identity and is never combined with --session-id.

hook.notes: Loopback HTTP bridge with bearer interpolation; SessionStart and Setup use the command forwarder because Claude 2.1.308 does not support HTTP for them. A print-mode process exits without awaiting StopFailure command hooks, so StopFailure must stay on HTTP.

transcript.notes: Durable JSONL is authoritative for message content; hook events remain authoritative for lifecycle. Besides user/assistant/system/attachment rows, 2.1.308 records per-request bookkeeping rows (api-request, api-request-shape, api-request-blob, atis-latch, cost-state) that are not conversation messages; api-request-blob rows carry message.role user or assistant without uuid or timestamp.

statusline.notes: Claude invokes the configured statusLine command with model, cost, context-window, workspace, and prompt-cache JSON on stdin (rate limits only for subscription accounts).

subagentStatusLine.notes: Claude invokes the configured child command with the currently visible task snapshot on stdin. Rolling tokenSamples omit timestamps, so consumers must use callback-time tokenCount for rate samples. Fields whose value is undefined are omitted from the JSON.

terminal.notes: Native TUI control only; semantic state is never parsed from terminal rendering.
